name: close
description: Represents dismissing, closing, or clearing. On hover the two strokes re-cross themselves in sequence.

animation.description: The backslash unwrites first, then the slash, then both rewrite in reverse order (0.12s each) — the crossing-out gesture re-enacted. Ends at rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: When used as a dialog or menu dismiss button, the parent button must provide the accessible name.
